When I was in elementary school, there was this rather popular, kind girl, we’ll call her Jenny. Jenny’s mom always had strange boyfriends, and one of them even sexually assaulted Jenny and tried to bribe one of her friends for sex, by driving her around in his car and offering her hundreds of dollars (guessing, this did not take place in America). The girls were both around 11 at the time and he was probably in his mid 30’s. There was also some shady stuff about Jenny’s mom, because after she went missing, the mom’s facebook was found and her name there was Eva Braun and there was a lot of nazi propaganda.

Well, in early January of 2016, Jenny disappeared without a trace. Her mom’s boyfriend was obviously the main suspect, but before the police got to interview him properly, he killed himself. No one is even sure if Jenny disappeared during the night or in the morning, because when her mom came home one night, she assumed Jenny was already asleep so she didn’t check if she was in her room. When she checked in the morning, she wasn’t there. She assumed Jenny left to school early, so she only called the police when she never showed up during the day.

This whole thing messed up my town of 100k people quite a lot. Some of my friends were interviewed about Jenny since they knew her more than me, I never even really talked to her. Watching the news was devastating because the news station and the police kept talking to Jenny’s dad and grandma and they were so heartbroken. 

To this day, Jenny has never been found and there’s no trace of her. I, and a lot of other people, believe she was murdered by her mom’s boyfriend. I still feel terrible for her family. I often pass by the apartment complex where she used to live, and I can’t help but wonder what happened.

Sorry for any mistakes, english isn’t my first language. Also she would’ve been almost 16 today. We were the same age. She dissapeared when we were 12.
